# Edward Scissorhands Barber Shop

> Two Melbourne barber shops: St Kilda (190 Carlisle Street, since 1991) and South Melbourne (The Clarendon Centre, 261 Clarendon Street). Open 7 days. Skin fades, scissor cuts, beard trims and boys' cuts. Standard haircuts from $46 in St Kilda and $49 in South Melbourne. Book online through Fresha.

## St Kilda
- [St Kilda home](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/st-kilda/): 190 Carlisle Street, St Kilda VIC 3182, corner of Chapel Street, near Balaclava station. Walk-ins welcome 7 days. Rated 5.0 on Fresha from 3,575 reviews (November 2026), the most-reviewed barber in St Kilda and Balaclava on Fresha; 4.8 on Google from 790+ reviews (November 2026).
- [Services and prices](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/st-kilda/services/)
- [FAQ](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/st-kilda/faq/): booking, walk-ins, parking, payment, kids' cuts
- [Contact and opening hours](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/st-kilda/contact/): reception 0485 071 024 (any hour, AI reception), shop (03) 9534 4546
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm; Saturday and Sunday 9am to 5pm.
- [Book online (Fresha)](https://l.fresha.com/0dwd7jy71): book a St Kilda appointment.
- [Our barbers and story](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/st-kilda/about/)

## South Melbourne
- [South Melbourne home](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/south-melbourne/): The Clarendon Centre, 261 Clarendon Street, South Melbourne VIC 3205, opposite Coles. Bookings recommended; walk-ins when a chair is free.
- [Services and prices](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/south-melbourne/services/)
- [FAQ](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/south-melbourne/faq/)
- [Contact and opening hours](https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/south-melbourne/contact/): shop (03) 9690 1604
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm; Saturday and Sunday 9am to 5pm.
- [Book online (Fresha)](https://l.fresha.com/06wr7vyk1): book a South Melbourne appointment.
